descriptionChirho: A receptacle or container for holding liquids, grain, or other substances, such as a pot, jar, bowl, or vat (Arabic: إِنَاء / آنِيَة).
An implement of war such as a sword, spear, bow, or defensive armor (Arabic: سِلاح / أَسْلِحَة; Korean: 무기; Swahili: silaha).
A device for making music, such as a harp, lyre, cymbal, or trumpet (Arabic: آلَة / آلَات with musical context; Korean: 악기; Hindi: वाद्य).
Personal property, belongings, luggage, or cargo carried on a journey or stored as possessions (Arabic: أَمْتِعَة / مَتَاع; Korean: 짐/물건; Swahili: vitu/mizigo).
A general object, article, or item of any kind, used in an abstract or unspecified sense (Arabic: مَتَاع in generic sense; Korean: 도구/물건).
Decorative items worn on the body such as jewelry, trinkets, or adornments (Arabic: حُلِيّ; Korean: 장식; Swahili: mapambo).
A flexible container such as a bag, sack, or pouch used for carrying or storing items (Arabic: كِيس; Swahili: mfuko).
